QuestInfo.name: Fiendish Matron
QuestInfo.0: Someone appears and attacks Yun Wu. She is the one behind all of this!
QuestInfo.1: Someone appears and attacks Yun Wu. She is the one behind all of this!
QuestInfo.2:
You defeated the leader of the Devil Clan, the Fiendish Matron, and celebrated your victory with the other pupils. 

The next chapter of the Xuanshan School begins right now. Although it's a far cry from its glory days, the legacies of its predecessors will be upheld. 
You will ensure that no one else will suffer the same pain and sadness that you have. 
#eThat is the duty... of Mo Xuan and the Xuanshan School!#n
